meta.notes: A cooking machine from the Machine flow (msm:machine) in a vanilla furnace screen: an ingredient, fuel and the meal. It burns fuel as a furnace does and takes its own recipes only, which are the element's recipes: a brown mushroom cooks into Forest Stew, a carrot into Root Stew and a pumpkin into Pumpkin Soup, ten seconds each, with a little experience when you take the meal. Each recipe becomes a data pack file data/msm_examples/recipe/camp_stove/<name>.json whose type is msm_examples:camp_stove; the vanilla data pack leaves them out. A machine recipe has one ingredient, so a pot that mixes several ingredients (or needs a bowl) is not possible yet. It turns its front to the player who places it and glows while it cooks.
